title: On a phone, Credit Terms and Credit Limit stay side by side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Use a phone (or a browser window 390 pixels wide with touch input).
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Tap the locked Credit Limit.
  3. Tap the Credit Limit again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.
  • They sit side by side on one row, as City / ZIP and State / Country do.

Step 2:

  • The explanation "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." shows under the field.

Step 3:

  • The explanation hides.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Story 5, Form factor: “Form factor: Mobile-optimized: Credit Terms and Credit Limit sit side by side at every width, as the window already pairs City / ZIP and State / Country; on a touch screen, tapping the locked Credit Limit shows the explanation under the field and tapping again hides it.”
  • S5-R4: “When the chosen term is COD or Credit Hold, Credit Limit shows $0.00 and is disabled; hovering it shows "COD and Credit Hold customers can't charge to account, so they have no credit limit." Choosing COD or Credit Hold sets the limit to $0.00.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
